name: GLOMAC
recent: GLOMAC 近期围绕企业活动与股权变动：完成以 RM49.18m 将 Puchong 土地出售给 Sunway Puchong，并公布 FY2027 计划推出 RM371m 的项目。公司 1QFY2027 转亏为盈，净利约 RM7.6m 至 RM8m。执行主席与董事总经理家族成员在公开市场持续小额增持股份。
notable: 完成以 RM49.18m 将 Puchong 土地出售给 Sunway Puchong。
公布 FY2027 计划推出总值 RM371m 的项目。
1QFY2027 转亏为盈，净利约 RM7.6m 至 RM8m。
risks: 董事与主要股东在闭门期及闭门期外多次申报小额增持股份。

recent_en: GLOMAC has seen corporate activity and shareholding changes: it completed the RM49.18m sale of Puchong land to Sunway Puchong and outlined RM371m of launches for FY2027. The company returned to profit in 1QFY2027 with net profit of about RM7.6m-8m. Family members of the executive chairman and managing director continued small open-market purchases.
notable_en: Completed the RM49.18m sale of Puchong land to Sunway Puchong.
Announced RM371m of planned launches for FY2027.
Returned to profit in 1QFY2027 with net profit of about RM7.6m-8m.
risks_en: Directors and substantial shareholders filed multiple small share purchases during and outside the closed period.
